The package uses standard AUR patterns for a -git package: fetching version metadata via curl from the project's own GitHub API in pkgver(), and downloading a source zip from the upstream repository. There is no execution of fetched content and no fetching from unrelated hosts. The qwen3 model's 'inconclusive' verdict was due to HTTP 400 API errors and carries no verdict signal. coverage_issues: qwen/qwen3-235b-a22b-2507 failed to audit critical files (PKGBUILD, LICENSE, REUSE.toml) due to HTTP 400 API errors, resulting in an incomplete review.
learnings: Implement retry logic or fallback mechanisms for LLM API calls to prevent transient HTTP 400 errors from causing incomplete audits and false inconclusive verdicts.

Ensure models are explicitly trained or prompted to recognize that fetching from a package's own declared upstream repository (even with SKIP checksums for mutable branches) is a standard AUR pattern and not an injection risk, provided the fetched content is not executed.
